notes.title: Minor Update - January 15th
notes.notes:
First update in the new 2022. Happy New Year everyone!

[list]
[*]Texture and material optimization. Removal of unnecessary features has added noticeable amount of fps while preserving the aesthetics.
[*]You know that long and sometimes annoying path towards the Tower of Mason that most players need to cross twice? Well, a new crafting spot has been added at the middle of it to allow the player to craft a shortcut and avoid going through multiple barrages of blue pills every time.
[*]Oh, and crafting spots now display level and cost with a marker-type UI instead of physical text plane facing the player.
[*]Fixed the bug with character keeping the previous playthrough's suit perk color in a new game. 
[*]UI improvements. Zone names have fancier animations, oxygen bar has lighter and more modern look. Right arm vitals hologram now looks more like a projection.
[*]Environment improvements. Dust and smoke is more intense and with adjusted colors. Soystorm clouds have more details and look more like clouds from the distance.
[*]Red pill containers don't just snap into existence anymore after 120 seconds. Now they hiss into existence along with a small smoke show.
[*]Outro girl is now a blue-eyed redhead with more natural look. Crashed pod has scratches and dirt.
[*]Some players may find a strange cave near the Art Hole. :)
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - December 25th
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays everyone, hope you are enjoying this time of the year as much as I do, and hope you'll enjoy the newest improvements in Converter.

[list]
[*]Rocks and stones lighting behavior has been drastically improved. Fixed a couple of rocks with blocky textures
[*]Big crystals' materials have been fixed
[*]Animations improvements. Occasional animation snapping some players experienced while rapidly jumping and running down the rock platforms has been fixed. Landing and foot position in air have been improved
[*]Terrain now has fog and dust slowly crawling over the gravel and sand 
[*]Improved and unified look for save spots, perks and info objects
[*]Soy Spheres, Soy Caves, Soy Launchers and Soy Rays lighting improvements
[*]Red Pills not blowing up while colliding with certain objects has been fixed as well 
[/list]

notes.title: Medium Update - World material overhaul
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40140457/0941ce22fa05eda55fbd30e3fb97e70c038b3507.png[/img]

Whew lads, this one improved a lot. 
[list]
[*]Most world materials have been adjusted and brought to higher resolution without performance impact.
[*]Rocks are now visibly higher quality, sporting realistic blending with the rest of terrain. Surface properties have been adjusted and rocks don't have weird plastic glow while observed from distance. Soy infused rocks have realistic glowing cracks instead of previous shiny scratches. More variations of materials while synchronizing the style have made the game's aesthetics miles better.
[*]Soydoors also have new, more appropriate and sinister material.
[*]Animations have been further improved, with jumping/falling transitions completely snap-free while at lower levels of Strength.
[*]Suit will now change its stripes color according to your perk tier. Activating perks will make the stripes glow as new powers are infused into our hero. 
[*]Footstep sounds on gravel have been made less appealing to ASMR crew. New ones are less crunchy.
[*]Main menu planet is a solid 8/10 now.
[*]Fixed perk activation prompt appearing during the second part of death screen if you die and respawn at any perk location. 
[*]Foliage reaction to player looks and feels more natural now.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - November 23rd
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]More realistic movement. I've noticed some complaints about the character movement feeling light and without proper momentum. This has been fixed and the movement should now be more natural. The character will feel heavier with realistic acceleration and braking.
[*]Fixed the rest of the moving textures on rocks.
[*]Leaning angle while moving next to slopes has been fixed and should feel more natural as well.
[*]EDIT: Left/right idle stance animations have been added. Character will now try to seamlessly choose his stance depending on the leg his weight was on while walking/running.  
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - July 24th
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Improvements to movement, walking/running/sprinting should feel better with slight camera sways (not one of those intrusive, nauseous shakes some games do)
[*]New perk ability: Collect red pill orbs with red pills. You've noticed that fat, juicy orb probably containing about 20 red pills, but it's unreachable? Shoot it with a red pill and get the spoils.
[*]Red pill orbs have been "balanced" so some of the perk abilities aren't almost useless. Yes, you'll now get fewer red pills unless you got one of the Collector perks. Or the secret epic perk.
[*][strike]Perception of 5 and above should give you slightly more range to spot the skills.[/strike] Screw it, all Perception levels can now see skill stripes, the distance will depend on the current Perception level. This has improved the exploration and skill searching fun by roughly 355%, while staying fair to the high Perception players.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update June 5th - Manual Save Point
notes.notes:
You asked, I sort of listened. Manual save points have been the request of a certain number of players. While speedrunners and hardcore platformer fans like the unforgiving nature of deaths in Converter, other players often needed a bit of help, mainly in the immenseness of the Dry Spell. Well, a healthy compromise have been introduced. 

[list]
[*]In the middle of the Dry Spell players can now occasionally use the Manual Save Point (MSP ingame) to ensure their respawn location after dying would be at the optimal distance from the majority of puzzles in that zone. After saving the game using MSP its cooldown time is 10 minutes if you are any level of Beta, and 5 minutes if you are any level of Alpha (because even virtual alien nature favors the strong), so plan your saves accordingly. The MSP will be shown to player upon collecting the Strength orb right after entering the Dry Spell.
[*]Mayor (non-tenet) story cutscenes now save your game as well upon completion, so you won't have to watch them again in case you die shortly after them.
[*]Aiming circular marker now works with Soyospheres as well
[*]Environment improvements and optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update June 2nd
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Visual and functional improvements to the aiming arc. Aiming should be more intuitive now as the aiming ark has a gradient fade helping the player estimate the distance easier. If that doesn't help, try the also added blazing red circle marking the impact location.
[*] Oxygen level now has percentage displayed next to the O2 bar. Some may say this was unnecessary, but try reaching an oxygen leak at 1% and tell me it didn't feel good living on the edge.
[*] Slight optimization and sand footstep particle color adjustment.
[/list]
